svg.title: Early Warning, Early Action framework for UNICEF funding
svg.desc: Strategic framework showing data sources flowing to predictions, triggering rapid response mechanisms, with emphasis on hyper-locality and child outcomes
svg.text: Early Warning, Early Action: Core Strategy

g.text: Forecasts: disease outbreaks, heat waves, flooding, air quality events

g.style: fill: #FAEEDA; stroke: #854F0B; stroke-width: 0.5; stroke-opacity: 0.4;;fill:rgb(250, 238, 218);stroke:rgb(133, 79, 11);color:rgb(255, 255, 255);stroke-width:0.5px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:"Anthropic Sans", -apple-system, "system-ui", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start;dominant-baseline:auto

g.text: ↓ Mortality | ↓ Malnutrition | ↓ School absence | ↑ Health facility readiness
↓ Heat stress in kids | ↑ Vaccination coverage | ↓ Waterborne disease incidence
Measured at 6/12 months post-alert (real data for funding cases)
